description: Tool to list BigQuery Links on a property. Use when you need to retrieve BigQuery link resources associated with a Google Analytics property. Results support pagination for large datasets.

inputSchema.description: Request model for listing BigQuery Links on a Google Analytics property.

pageSize.description: Optional. Maximum number of resources to return. The service may return fewer than this value. If unspecified, at most 50 resources will be returned. The maximum value is 200; higher values will be coerced to the maximum.
pageSize.title: Page Size

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous ListBigQueryLinks call. Provide this to retrieve the subsequent page. When paginating, all other parameters provided to ListBigQueryLinks must match the call that provided the page token.
pageToken.title: Page Token

parent.description: Required. The name of the property to list BigQuery links under. Format: properties/{property_id} (e.g., properties/1234).
parent.title: Parent

inputSchema.title: AnalyticsAdminPropertiesBigQueryLinksListRequest

name: list_bigquery_links

AnalyticsAdminPropertiesBigQueryLinksLis.description: Response model for listing BigQuery Links.

nextPageToken.description: Token for retrieving the subsequent page. Omitted if no further pages exist.
nextPageToken.title: Next Page Token

AnalyticsAdminPropertiesBigQueryLinksLis.title: AnalyticsAdminPropertiesBigQueryLinksListResponse

createTime.description: Output only. Time when the link was created (google-datetime format).
createTime.title: Create Time

dailyExportEnabled.description: If true, enables daily data export to the linked Google Cloud project.
dailyExportEnabled.title: Daily Export Enabled

datasetLocation.description: Immutable. Geographic location where the BigQuery dataset resides.
datasetLocation.title: Dataset Location

excludedEvents.description: List of event names that are excluded from exports.
excludedEvents.title: Excluded Events

exportStreams.description: List of streams under the parent property for which data will be exported.
exportStreams.title: Export Streams

freshDailyExportEnabled.description: If true, enables fresh daily export to the linked Google Cloud project.
freshDailyExportEnabled.title: Fresh Daily Export Enabled

includeAdvertisingId.description: If true, exported data includes advertising identifiers for mobile app streams.
includeAdvertisingId.title: Include Advertising Id

name.description: Output only. Resource name of this BigQuery link. Format: properties/{property_id}/bigQueryLinks/{bigquery_link_id}.
name.title: Name

project.description: Immutable. The linked Google Cloud project (project number or project ID).
project.title: Project

streamingExportEnabled.description: If true, enables streaming export of data to the linked Google Cloud project.
streamingExportEnabled.title: Streaming Export Enabled
